title: Archive extraction can write outside the temporary directory
reasoning: The project supports Python 3.12 and 3.13, where tar extraction without an explicit filter permits traversal paths and escaping links. Parsing a supplied artifact archive can therefore overwrite files accessible to the host process outside temp_dir. Removing temp_dir afterward does not undo those writes.
reproduction: On Python 3.12 or 3.13, pass an archive containing a member with a ../ path targeting a harmless sentinel outside the extraction directory. Extraction writes the sentinel before parser detection completes.
recommendation: Pass filter="data" explicitly to extractall and translate rejected or invalid archives into ParseError.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied tests do not exercise compressed trajectory parsing or malicious archive members.
suggestedRegressionTest: Test traversal, absolute paths, and escaping links on the minimum supported Python version; assert extraction fails without creating files outside the temporary directory.
minimumFixScope: parse_trajectory archive extraction and focused archive safety coverage.
